v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Cor contrítum * et humiliátum, Deus, non despícies.
text.en: A contrite and a humbled heart, * O God, thou wilt not despise.

text.la: Propter nomen tuum, * Dómine, vivificábis me in æquitáte tua.
text.en: For thy name's sake, * O Lord, thou wilt quicken me in thy justice.

text.la: Deus, tu convérsus * vivificábis nos, et plebs tua lætábitur in te.
text.en: Thou wilt turn, O God, * Thou wilt quicken us and bring us to life.

text.la: Cum irátus fúeris, * Dómine, misericórdiæ recordáberis.
text.en: When thou art angry, * O Lord, thou wilt remember mercy.

text.la: Lauda * Deum tuum, Sion, qui annúntiat iudícia sua Israël.
text.en: Praise thy God, * O Sion, who declareth his judgments to Israel.

text.la: Nox præcéssit, dies autem appropinquávit. Abiciámus ergo ópera tenebrárum, et induámur arma lucis. Sicut in die honéste ambulémus.
text.en: The night is passed, and the day is at hand. Let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and put on the armour of light. Let us walk honestly, as in the day.

v.en: We are filled in the morning with thy mercy.

r.en: And we have rejoiced, and are delighted.

text.la: Per víscera misericórdiæ * Dei nostri visitávit nos Óriens ex alto.
text.en: Through the tender mercy * of our God, the dayspring from on high has visited us.

text.la: Preces pópuli tui, quǽsumus, Dómine, cleménter exáudi: ut, qui iuste pro peccátis nostris afflígimur, pro tui nóminis glória misericórditer liberémur.
text.en: O Lord, we beseech thee favourably to hear the prayers of thy people; that we, who are justly punished for our offences, may be mercifully delivered by thy goodness, for the glory of thy Name.

text.la: Qui odit ánimam suam in hoc mundo, in vitam ætérnam custódit eam.
text.en: He that hateth his life in this world, shall keep it unto life eternal.

v.en: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree.

r.en: He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

text.la: Infirmitátem nostram réspice, omnípotens Deus: et, quia pondus própriæ actiónis gravat, beáti Simeónis Mártyris tui atque Pontíficis intercéssio gloriósa nos prótegat.
text.en: Mercifully consider our weakness, O Almighty God, and whereas by the burden of our sins we are sore, may the glorious intercession of blessed Simeon, Your Martyr and Bishop, sustain us.
